# apple_beta_recruitment_criteria (Resource)

Limits who can join an external beta group's public link to testers with the listed device families and OS versions. The `apple_beta_recruitment_criterion_options` data source lists the values App Store Connect accepts. Import it by beta group ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_beta_recruitment_criteria" "public" {
  beta_group_id = apple_beta_group.public.id
  filters = [
    { device_family = "IPHONE", minimum_os_version = "18.0" },
    { device_family = "IPAD", minimum_os_version = "18.0" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an external beta group. Changing it creates new criteria.
- `filters` (Attributes List) Device families and OS version ranges testers must match. Changes are made in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the criteria.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `device_family` (String) Device family: `APPLE_TV`, `APPLE_WATCH`, `IPAD`, `IPHONE`, `MAC`, `VISION`.

Optional:

- `maximum_os_version` (String) Highest OS version allowed.
- `minimum_os_version` (String) Lowest OS version allowed, e.g. `17.0`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_recruitment_criteria.public
  identity = {
    beta_group_id = "9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `beta_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_recruitment_criteria.public 9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4
```
